title: Card HistorySource never trims rows past its 48 h span: retained rows grow linearly with the card's life
claim: On a long-lived card element whose plan dialog is panned into the past once a day, HistorySource retains 1,448 more rows per day (log 476, actionLog 152, seen keys 628, memoized overlay points 192; 60 covered chunks after 30 days against a 48 h reach of 4-5), with no plateau, while its own HISTORY_SPAN_MS caps what it can ever show at 48 h.
mechanism: HistorySource is built once per card element (constructor) and survives every dialog session (ViewWindow.onDialogClosed resets only the range). absorb() appends every fetched row to this.log[field], this.actionLog and this.seen, and fetchChunk adds each chunk to this.covered; ensure() deletes only the stale live-edge chunk's 'loaded' mark. Nothing drops a row older than Date.now() - HISTORY_SPAN_MS, and overlays() re-materialises one point per plan step of every covered chunk into this.memo, so the memo also grows per day.

evidence.unit: retained rows per day (log + actionLog + seen + memo points), days 3-30
evidence.machine: Linux x86_64 container B2, node v22.23.4
evidence.contention_note: count is contention-immune; heap_slope 140,157 B/day printed beside it is provisional (load1 8.5, two Python harnesses of this seat running)
evidence.tolerance: exact for this fixture (tests/card_rig.mjs realisticHistory); +-1 % across fixture edits

instrumented_symbol: custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/www/heatpump-optimizer-card.js:HistorySource (ensure, fetchChunk, absorb, overlays), driven through tests/card_rig.mjs historyApi

perturbation.change: --arm trim: in-memory one-line edit of the card source, absorb()'s add() splices samples older than Date.now() - HISTORY_SPAN_MS after its sort
perturbation.observed_value: log_rows_slope 476 -> 0.0 rows/day, memo_points_slope 192 -> 0.0; total 1448 -> 780 (actionLog and seen, untrimmed by this one line, still grow 152 + 628/day)

metric_definition: Rows held by one HistorySource (log, actionLog, seen, memo points) after each simulated day; slope per day between day 3 and day 30.
phenomenon_property: Every per-session collection of HistorySource (log, actionLog, seen, covered, memo) is bounded by HISTORY_SPAN_MS: after any number of days its size is at most what a fresh 48 h window holds.

null_control.note: the same 30 days with the dialog never panned: no fetch, 0 rows retained, heap slope 1,320 B/day (noise); growth is caused by the history fetch path, not by the clock or the rig

proposed_fix_scope: HistorySource: drop log/actionLog rows, seen keys and covered chunks older than Date.now() - HISTORY_SPAN_MS when a chunk is absorbed (or clear the collaborator when the dialog session ends), and build overlays only over covered chunks inside the span.
